```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
# Game lines only from the complete seasons, so the season still being played
# does not change the spread.
complete_through <- last_complete_cfb_season()
pos <- signature_positions(collect(tbl(con, "roster")))
pg <- collect(tbl(con, "player_game")) |>
  filter(season <= complete_through)
game_values <- signature_game_values(build_game_production(pg), pos)

titles <- list(
  title = "Which position's yardage swings most from game to game?",
  subtitle = "Each game's yards against a typical player's, by opponent Elo band; boxes hold the middle half of games",
  x = "Opponent band",
  y = "Yards against a typical player",
  caption = card_caption(release)
)

spread <- residual_spread(game_values)
p <- spread |>
  mutate(
    tooltip = paste0(
      group,
      ": game residual SD ",
      fmt(sd, 1),
      " yards, ",
      fmt(rel_sd, 2),
      " of the group's mean yards per game"
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(rel_sd, reorder(group, rel_sd), fill = group)) +
  geom_col_interactive(aes(tooltip = tooltip), width = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = position_palette(), guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = titles$title,
    subtitle = "Game-to-game spread as a share of each group's mean yards per game",
    x = "Residual SD over mean yards per game",
    y = NULL,
    caption = titles$caption
  ) +
  theme_card()

# The hover summary for each box: its median and middle half, in yards.
box_tips <- game_values |>
  group_by(group, band) |>
  summarise(
    med = median(residual),
    q1 = quantile(residual, 0.25),
    q3 = quantile(residual, 0.75),
    games = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    tip = paste0(
      group,
      ", ",
      band,
      ": median ",
      fmt(med, 1),
      ", middle half ",
      fmt(q1, 1),
      " to ",
      fmt(q3, 1),
      " over ",
      fmt(games),
      " games"
    )
  )

p_interactive <- game_values |>
  left_join(box_tips |> select(group, band, tip), by = c("group", "band")) |>
  ggplot(aes(band, residual, fill = group)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_boxplot_interactive(
    aes(tooltip = tip, data_id = interaction(group, band)),
    outlier.shape = NA,
    width = 0.6
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = position_palette(), guide = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~group, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = titles$title,
    subtitle = titles$subtitle,
    x = titles$x,
    y = titles$y,
    caption = titles$caption
  ) +
  theme_card() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1))

card_thumbnail(p, "game-to-game-yardage-spread", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
card_interactive(p_interactive)
```

```{r}
#| label: spread-table
# The spread on the yardage scale of each group, which the boxes cannot show:
# the standard deviation as a share of a typical game's yards.
residual_spread(game_values) |>
  transmute(
    `Position group` = group,
    Games = fmt(games),
    `Residual SD` = fmt(sd, 1),
    `90th percentile` = fmt(p90, 1),
    `SD over mean yards` = fmt(rel_sd, 2)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c(
      "Position group",
      "Games",
      "Residual SD",
      "90th percentile",
      "SD over mean yards"
    ),
    caption = paste0(
      "Spread of each group's game residuals in yards, over the seasons through ",
      complete_through,
      ". The last column divides the standard deviation by the group's mean yards per game, so groups on different yardage scales compare."
    )
  )
```
